data.name: Thatta Cement Company Limited
data.description: Thatta Cement Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1980 as a public limited Company. The Company's main business activity is manufacturing and marketing of cement. The Company owns shareholding of Thatta Power (Private) Limited.
